items.summary: moatlib.load_status falls back to origin/main BEFORE origin/port/<name>, so on a host without the project folder checked out it returns the stale trunk record for any re-homed project (the re-home cannot delete from the protected trunk). Surfaced in popsift's merge-fix: the round listing (branch-record path) said READY while record_pr_approval (load_status path) saw no fix.review_pr, so 'upstream.py --merge-fix --apply' failed from the main checkout and only worked when run from the project worktree. Fix candidates: prefer origin/port/<name> when it exists, or prefer the newer of the two records. Control-plane change; needs trunk review.
